name: Review, Versioning & Approval Workflow
marker: STAGE_11_PASS — REVIEW, VERSIONING & APPROVAL WORKFLOW CERTIFIED

implementation_summary.objective: Implement a production-grade timetable review, immutable versioning, change-request, approval and controlled release workflow on top of Stage 8.x manual editing/policy/feasibility foundation, Stage 9 generation engine and Stage 10 simulation/recovery engine.

versioning_architecture.immutability: Snapshots cannot be modified in place after creation; modifying an approved/historical version creates a new child version snapshot
versioning_architecture.fingerprinting: Deterministic SHA-256 over timetable coordinates and allocations
versioning_architecture.provenance: Stores generation_run_id, simulation_id, manual_edit_session_id, feasibility_run_id, validation_run_id

review_model.comments: INFO, WARNING, BLOCKING severities supported; unresolved BLOCKING comments strictly prevent transition to READY_FOR_APPROVAL
review_model.change_requests: Full lifecycle tracking (OPEN, IN_PROGRESS, IMPLEMENTED, REJECTED, CANCELLED)

diff_engine.granularity: Event-level additions, removals, moves, room changes, faculty changes, section changes, duration changes
diff_engine.atomicity: 2-hour lab continuity and shared multi-section/multi-faculty synchronizations preserved as single logical movements

security.rbac: Server-side default-deny RBAC for SUPER_ADMIN, TIMETABLE_ADMIN, TEACHER, VIEWER
security.audit: Append-only audit trail logging 22 distinct lifecycle events
